topography.project_purpose: Nomiswap is a decentralized exchange (DEX) on BSC that enables users to swap tokens, provide liquidity, and stake assets. It includes both standard and stable swap factories for different pool types, along with a staking service for earning rewards.
topography.relationship_narrative: The single product family encompasses all core contracts, with the factories creating liquidity pools and the staking service likely interacting with the NMX token for rewards. No separate families or shared infrastructure are evident from the contract surface.
